title: French Onion Pasta
creator: bytheforkful_

items.note: large white onion (or 2–3 medium), thinly sliced
grated, plus extra for the top

steps: Cook the sliced onion in the oil over low heat for 15–20 minutes until soft.
Add salt, pepper and the butter and keep cooking, stirring often, for about 20 minutes more until deep golden.
Add the balsamic vinegar, thyme and garlic and sauté for 2 minutes.
Stir in the flour, then deglaze with the white wine and cook for 5–8 minutes until it has evaporated.
Add the pasta and stock, cover and simmer for about 10 minutes until the pasta is cooked, stirring now and then and adding stock if needed.
Stir in the cream and cheese until melted.
Top with more cheese and grill until golden and bubbling (as in the video), or serve straight away with black pepper.
